assertions.assertion: CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) is medically necessary
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess the efficacy of current management strategies
Prairie State Medicaid issued CO-22 citing coordination of benefits
The clinical indication for arrhythmia correlation remains documented
Proof of primary liability resolution is pending per the payer's written request
